I have independently reviewed the **Shift Notes** application and recorded the release verdict in [`REVIEW.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-aXiUW9/workspace/REVIEW.md).

### Release Verdict: **BLOCK**

### Key Findings
* **Empty Client Page:** [`public/index.html`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-aXiUW9/workspace/public/index.html) contains no UI elements or scripts, rendering the tablet app completely non-functional for nurses.
* **Data Loss Vulnerability:** [`src/store.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-aXiUW9/workspace/src/store.js#L8) truncates the notes file on server startup, causing all handover notes to be wiped upon reboot.
* **Access Control Bypass:** [`src/server.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-aXiUW9/workspace/src/server.js#L31) permits reading notes from any ward via query parameter without verifying the session's assigned ward.
* **Unthrottled Email Endpoint:** [`src/server.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-aXiUW9/workspace/src/server.js#L45) permits unauthenticated password reset mail queuing without rate limiting.
* **Operability Checks:** Automated checks failed on missing health endpoints and operations documentation.

---

### What Was Verified
1. Ran the automated product acceptance suite (`accept-check.js`) under independent acceptor context (`--acceptor-context separate`).
2. Audited source files ([`src/server.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-aXiUW9/workspace/src/server.js), [`src/store.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-aXiUW9/workspace/src/store.js), [`src/notes.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-aXiUW9/workspace/src/notes.js), [`public/index.html`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-aXiUW9/workspace/public/index.html)) against security, data integrity, and architectural specifications.
3. Evaluated [`ux-walkthrough.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-aXiUW9/workspace/ux-walkthrough.md) requirements against available static assets.
4. Verified unit test results (`npm test`).
